column1: The Wednesday before Thanksgiving we discussed the notion of a ring R being an integral domain, the important class of rings; and in fact all the rings we're going to study from now on are going to be integral domains.
column2: 在感恩节前的那个周三，我们讨论了环 R 作为整环的概念，这是一类非常重要的环；事实上，我们从现在起要研究的所有环都将是整环。

column1: So an integral domain has got the property that if a times b is equal to 0 in R, then either a is equal to 0 or b is equal to 0 in R. Namely, no product is 0 unless it's stupidly 0—it's multiplication of something by 0.
column2: 整环具有这样的性质：如果在 R 中 a 乘 b 等于 0，那么在 R 中要么 a 等于 0，要么 b 等于 0。也就是说，除非显然是平凡的零，否则乘积不会为零——即某个数与 0 相乘。

column1: So as examples of domains, we had the integers, we had polynomials over a field, and if R is an integral domain, so is R[x], polynomials over R. So we have many examples of domains.
column2: 作为整环的例子，我们有整数环，有域上的多项式环；而且若 R 是整环，R[x]即 R 上的多项式环也是整环。所以我们有许多整环的例子。

column1: Non-examples are rings like Z/4Z, where 2 times 2 is equal to 0, but neither 2 nor 2 is 0; and what we showed on Wednesday, for those of you who took a quick break, is associated to any integral domain is a natural field which we could call
column2: 非整环的例子如环 Z/4Z，其中 2 乘 2 等于 0，但两个因子都不为 0；而我们在周三证明的（对那些稍事休息的同学而言）是：与任何整环相伴的都有一个自然的域，

column1: the field of fractions that contains R as a subring, and it's somehow the smallest field that can contain R in the sense that all you've done is formally invert nonzero elements.
column2: 我们可以称之为分式域，它包含 R 作为子环，并且在某种意义上是包含 R 的最小域，因为你所做的只是形式上求逆了所有非零元素。

column1: And the way we define this field of fractions, just to recall this for you—oh, Peter, you have the homework?
column2: 回顾一下我们定义这个分式域的方法——噢，彼得，你有作业题了？

column1: Thanks: 11.1.1, 11.1.4, 11.1.5, 11.2.2, 11.2.5, and 11.2.11 Part A. There we go, thanks Peter, well done!

Anyhow, the way we defined the field of fractions, just to recall it for you, was: F was defined as a set modulo an equivalence relation, and it was the set of all expressions of the form a/b, where b was not equal to 0 in R and a was an arbitrary element in R. So that's what I mean by fractions.
column2: 无论如何，回顾一下我们定义分式域的方法：F 被定义为一个集合模去一个等价关系，它是所有形如 a/b 的表达式的集合，其中 b 在 R 中不为 0，而 a 是 R 中的任意元素。这就是我所说的分式。

column1: But you have to take the equivalence classes on that set, where you said that the fraction a/b was equivalent to the fraction a'/b' if and only if a b' was equal to a' b in R.
column2: 但你必须在该集合上取等价类，其中规定分式 a/b 等价于分式 a'/b'，当且仅当在 R 中 a b' = a' b。

column1: So if you constructed the field of fractions from the integers, you would get the rational numbers, and you have to remember that 2/6 is the same rational number as 1/3, even though they look like different symbols here.
column2: 因此如果你从整数环构造分式域，你就会得到有理数域，而且大家必须记住 2/6 和 1/3 是同一个有理数，尽管它们这里的符号看起来不同。

column1: So last time, what we showed on Wednesday—and it's one careful thing that's discussed in the last part of Chapter 10 in the book— is that on this set of equivalence classes you can put in addition and a multiplication, and R is embedded in F by taking a to the fraction a/1, or the equivalence class of a/1.
column2: 所以上次在周三我们所展示的——这是书中第 10 章最后一部分仔细讨论的一件事——就是在这个等价类集合上，你可以定义加法和乘法；并且 R 通过将 a 映为分式 a/1（即 a/1 的等价类）而嵌入到 F 中。

column1: And that gives inverses, because now this has inverse the fraction 1/a if a is nonzero; you can only make a fraction where the denominator is nonzero.
column2: 这给出了逆元，因为若 a非零，它就拥有逆元 1/a；分式的分母只能为非零元。

column1: So this is just a big enough set to contain the inverses, and you can do this for any domain; and we identified the field of fractions for these various domains.
column2: 因此这个集合恰好足够大以包含所有逆元，你对任何整环都可以这么做，我们为这些不同的整环确定了分式域。

column1: It's more of a convenience to know that the domain is sitting somewhere inside of a field; as Peter would say, it increases your comfort level with the domain.
column2: 知道整环坐落在某个域中更多是一种便利，正如彼得所说，这能增加你对该整环的心理舒适度。

column1: So we're going to go on now and study some wonderful properties of domains related to factorization of elements in domains, that are all intended to generalize the question of factorization of an integer into primes—one of the big theorems of classical arithmetic.
column2: 现在我们要继续前行，研究整环的一些绝妙性质，这些性质与整环中元素的因式分解相关，旨在推广将整数分解为素数的理论——这是古典算术中最伟大的定理之一。

column1: Now if we do factorization in the ring R, in the domain R = Z, and you follow the way you prove uniqueness of prime factorization in Euclid, it starts off with: the first property that we proved about the integers is the existence of the Euclidean algorithm.
column2: 现在如果我们在环 R、在整环 R = Z 中做因数分解，并沿着欧几里得证明素数分解唯一性的方法，它始于：我们关于整数证明的第一个性质是欧几里得算法的存在性。

column1: So that's the Euclidean algorithm, which says that if you have two integers a and b with a less than b, or maybe the absolute value of a less than the absolute value of b because they could be negative integers,
column2: 这就是欧几里得算法，它指出如果你有两个整数 a 和 b，满足 a 小于 b，或者说 a 的绝对值小于b 的绝对值（因为它们可能是负整数），

column1: then you can write b is a multiple of a plus a remainder term, where the remainder is a positive number which is less than the absolute value of a. So you can always take away a multiple of a from b to leave a term which is strictly less than the absolute value of a.
column2: 那么你可以将 b 写成 a 的倍数加上一个余数项，其中余数是一个严格小于 |a| 的非负数。所以你总能从 b 中减去 a 的某个倍数，留下的项严格小于|a|。

column1: That's more or less obvious from the geometric description of the integers. So here would be b, here would be your smaller number a.
column2: 这从整数的几何描述来看或多或少是显而易见的。这里是 b，这里是你较小的数 a。

column1: You march out, and ma would be the last time you got something that was strictly less than b, and then (m + 1)a would be here.
column2: 你一步步跨出，ma 是最后一次严格小于 b 的位置，然后 (m + 1)a 就会落在后面。

column1: And so the difference between ma and b—here's the remainder r—would be a number less than a.
column2: 因此 ma 与 b 之间的差值——这就是余数 r——是一个小于 a 的数。

column1: So you can't always divide in the integers, but you can approximately divide, leaving a difference which is smaller than the number you're dividing by. That's the principle of the Euclidean algorithm.
column2: 所以你不能总在整数中整除，但你可以近似相除，留下一个比除数更小的差值。这就是欧几里得算法的原理。

column1: And from the Euclidean algorithm, we deduced a number of consequences for the integers, and the first one was: every ideal—every ideal I, say not equal to 0, is principal, generated by the smallest positive integer d which is in it.
column2: 从欧几里得算法中，我们为整数推导出了若干推论，第一条就是：每个理想——每个非零理想 I——都是主理想，由其中最小的正整数 d 生成。

column1: So in any ideal which is nonzero, it contains both positive and negative integers; you find the smallest positive integer, note that then the ideal has to be multiples of d, because if you had anything else in the ideal,
column2: 所以在任何非零理想中，它既包含正整数也包含负整数；找到最小的正整数，注意此时该理想必定是 d 的所有倍数，因为如果理想中还有其他任何元素，

column1: say b in the ideal, and you wrote it as a multiple of d plus some remainder term, then since b is in the ideal and the multiple of d is in the ideal, the remainder has to be in the ideal.
column2: 比如理想中的 b，你把它写成 d 的倍数加上某个余数项，那么由于 b 在理想中且 d 的倍数在理想中，余数也必须在该理想中。

column1: But the remainder is less than d, so it has to be 0! So that shows that anything in the ideal is a multiple of d.
column2: 但余数小于 d，因此它必须为 0！这就证明了理想中的任何元素都是 d 的倍数。

column1: So that's the first thing we deduced. Second thing from that, which was quick: in particular, ideals generated by two elements are principal.
column2: 所以这是我们推导出的第一件事。由此得出的第二件事很快：特别地，由两个元素生成的理想是主理想。

column1: In particular, the ideal I that's generated by two numbers a and b is a principal ideal (d), with d equal to ma + nb.
column2: 特别是，由两个数 a 和 b 生成的理想 I 是主理想 (d)，其中 d = ma + nb。

column1: Because the ideal generated by two integers consists of all integers of this form, that has to be a principal ideal generated by something by Part 1, and consequently whatever generates the ideal has this expression.
column2: 因为由两个整数生成的理想包含该形式的所有整数，根据第 1 部分它必是由某元素生成的主理想，从而生成该理想的元素必定具有这种表达式。

column1: And in fact, from that we can conclude that d is the greatest common divisor of a and b.
column2: 事实上由此我们可以得出 d 是 a 和 b 的最大公因数。

column1: First of all, it divides a and b, because a is in the ideal generated by d, so a is a multiple of d; it divides b, because b is in the ideal generated by d, so b is a multiple of d.
column2: 首先，它整除 a 和 b，因为 a 在 d 生成的理想中，故 a 是 d 的倍数；它整除 b，因为 b 在d 生成的理想中，故 b 是 d 的倍数。

column1: And moreover, if you had anything dividing both a and b, it would have to divide d by this expression, because if it divides a and b, it divides ma + nb.
column2: 此外，如果有任何数同时整除 a 和 b，它必须根据这个表达式整除 d，因为如果它整除 a 和 b，它就整除 ma + nb。

column1: So that shows that d is the greatest common divisor: it itself is divisible by anything that divides a and b.
column2: 这就表明 d 是最大公因数：任何整除 a 和 b 的数都能整除它。

column1: So that just comes from the fact that every ideal is principal; applying it to the ideal with two elements, you get the existence of the greatest common divisor.
column2: 这仅源于每个理想都是主理想这一事实；将其应用于两个元素生成的理想，就得到了最大公因数的存在性。

column1: All right, that's the second thing we deduce from the Euclidean algorithm.
column2: 好，这是我们从欧几里得算法推导出的第二件事。

column1: And the third thing we deduce—and this is a nice thing that is in Euclid: if p is a prime and p divides a product ab, then either p divides a or p divides b. This is a symbol for divides (|), I'm not going to keep writing 'divides'.
column2: 第三件推导出的事——这是欧几里得中的优美定理：如果 p 是素数且 p 整除乘积 ab，那么要么 p 整除 a，要么 p 整除 b。这是整除符号（|），我不会一直写“整除”两个字。

column1: If a prime divides a product, it must divide one of the factors. And the proof of this follows from Part 2.
column2: 如果素数整除乘积，它必整除其中一个因子。其证明直接来自第 2 部分。

column1: Proof: if p does not divide a, then the gcd of a and p is equal to 1, because the only divisors of p are 1 and p.
column2: 证明：如果 p 不整除 a，那么 a 和 p 的最大公因数等于 1，因为 p 的正因子只有 1 和 p。

column1: So if p doesn't divide a, the largest divisor of both of these has to be 1, which means that 1 can be written, by Part 2, as a multiple of a plus a multiple of p: 1 = ma + np. And now multiply this by b, and you get that b is a multiple of a times b plus n times p times b.
column2: 所以如果 p不整除 a，两者的最大公因数必为 1，这意味着由第 2 部分，1 可以写为 a 的倍数加上 p 的倍数：1 = ma + np。现在将此式乘以 b，得到 b 是 a 乘 b 的倍数加上 n 乘 p乘 b。

column1: Now p divides the quantity ab; p certainly divides this because it's a multiple of p; so therefore p divides this sum, so b is divisible by p.
column2: 现在 p 整除数量 ab；p 当然整除这一项因为它包含 p；因此 p 整除它们的和，故 b 可被 p 整除。

column1: But we needed this mysterious expression of 1 to be able to prove it, and this is not obvious at all! We're going to have rings where this is false.
column2: 但我们需要这个将 1 表达出来的神奇式子才能证明它，这绝非显然！我们后面会遇到该结论不成立的环。

column1: So to prove that a prime which divides the product divides either factor, we needed this greatest common divisor.
column2: 所以要证明整除乘积的素数必整除其中一个因子，我们需要这个最大公因数。

column1: And the fourth thing we can deduce from this, I'm going to put it up here, (4), is that every integer n has a unique factorization into primes: n is equal to, well depending on its sign, \pm p_1 p_2 ... These could be the same prime,
column2: 从这里能推导出的第四件事——我写在上面，(4) 是每个整数 n 都有唯一的素因数分解：n 等于（取决于其正负号）± p₁ p₂ ...这些素数可以相同，

column1: the same prime could appear several times, but the key thing is not that it has a factorization—that's obvious, that you could just keep breaking an integer up into indivisible factors—but that the factors themselves are determined by the integer,
column2: 同一个素数可以出现若干次；但关键不在于它有因数分解——那是显而易见的，你总可以把整数不断分解为不可再分的因子——而是这些因子本身由该整数唯一确定，

column1: and that it has a unique factorization is a powerful theorem about the integers. And the reason this follows from (3) is you prove this by induction—by induction on the number of factors.
column2: 拥有唯一分解是关于整数的一个强力定理。它之所以由 (3) 导出，是因为你可以用数学归纳法证明——对因子的个数进行归纳。

column1: And just to sketch it, I mean suppose n were also equal to \pm q_1 up to q_l, and k was less than or equal to l, and this theorem were true for numbers that had less than k prime factors.
column2: 简要概述一下，假设 n 也等于 ± q₁ ... qₗ，且k ≤ l，并且该唯一定理对素因子个数少于 k 的数均成立；那么你会说：看，p₁ 整除 n，所以它整除一串素数的乘积。

column1: Then you would say, 'Well look: p_1 divides n, so it divides a product of primes.' Well, it's easy to go from this theorem that if a prime—if something divides a product, it has to divide a factor. So p_1 divides q_1 times the rest, so it either divides q_1 or it divides the rest.
column2: 从该定理很容易推得：若一个素数——整除乘积，它必整除某个因子。因此 p₁ 整除 q₁ 乘以其余部分，故它要么整除 q₁，要么整除其余部分。

column1: If it divides q_1, it's equal to q_1; if it divides the rest, it has to divide one of these factors, so you conclude from (3) that p_1 divides some q_i, which implies that p_1 is equal to some q_i.
column2: 若整除 q₁，它就等于 q₁；若整除其余部分，它必整除这些因子中的某一个；所以由 (3) 可知 p₁ 整除某个 q_i，从而 p₁ 等于某个 q_i。

column1: And then dividing both sides by p_1, we get a number with less than k prime factors, which has a unique prime factorization. But again, we needed this property (3), that if a prime divided a product, it divided one of the factors.
column2: 两边同时除以 p₁，我们得到一个素因子少于 k 个的数，它具有唯一的素因数分解。但我们再次需要性质 (3)，即若素数整除乘积，它必整除其中一个因子。

column1: So divide and use induction.
column2: 于是相除并应用归纳法。

column1: So ultimately we see that this uniqueness of factorization in the integers follows completely from the existence of this Euclidean algorithm: we deduced first of all that ideals are principal; from that, we deduced the existence of a gcd; from that, we deduced this theorem about primes; and finally, the uniqueness of factorization—they all follow from that.
column2: 最终我们看到，整数分解的唯一性完全源于欧几里得算法的存在：我们首先推得理想皆为主理想；由此推得最大公因数的存在；由此推得关于素数的定理；最后是分解的唯一性——它们全由算法导出。

column1: Now what we're going to do is see when this thing holds for other rings.
column2: 现在我们要做的是看该性质何时对其他环成立。

column1: So if we can establish a property like the Euclidean algorithm for another ring, all these things are just formal ring-theoretic properties; they have nothing to do with being integers.
column2: 如果我们能为另一个环确立类似欧几里得算法的性质，所有这些结论都只是纯粹的形式环论性质，与元素是否是整数毫无关系。

column1: So let's see another example where we can get the exact same mileage out of this. Another ring R with a Euclidean algorithm is the polynomials over a field F[x], where F is a field.
column2: 让我们看另一个能获得完全相同威力与成效的例子。另一个具有欧几里得算法的环 R 是域上的多项式环 F[x]，其中 F 是域。

column1: And then what we know for polynomials over a field: here we have the size of a number, its absolute value; so for a polynomial over a field, we have its degree.
column2: 对于域上的多项式，我们知道：在整数中有数的大小（绝对值）；而对于域上的多项式，我们有它的次数。

column1: So we know that given g(x), it can be written as a multiple of f(x): g(x) = f(x) q(x) + r(x), where the degree of r is less than the degree of f(x). That's just polynomial division!
column2: 所以我们知道给定 g(x)，它可以写成 f(x) 的倍数：g(x) = f(x) q(x) + r(x)，其中r 的次数小于 f(x) 的次数。这正是多项式带余除法！

column1: So that's our analogue of the Euclidean algorithm: that any two polynomials, if you're given g and f, it's not always the case that f divides g, but it can be divided into g in a way that leaves a polynomial
column2: 这就是我们欧几里得算法的对应物：任意两个多项式，若给定 g 和 f，虽然 f 不一定整除 g，但可以用 f 除 g 从而留下一个次数更低的多项式，

column1: whose degree is smaller, just like it can be divided into b in a way that leaves an integer which is in some sense smaller than your original integer you're dividing by.
column2: 正如用 a 除 b 留下一个在某种意义上比原始除数更小的整数一样。好，现在我可以推导出 (1)、(2)、(3) 和 (4)。

column1: All right, and now I can deduce (1), (2), (3), and (4). (1) is that every ideal is principal, generated by the d(x) of least degree in I, same proof.
column2: (1) 是每个理想都是主理想，由 I 中次数最低的 d(x) 生成——证明相同。

column1: (2) Any two polynomials f and g have a greatest common divisor, namely a polynomial d(x) which generates the ideal generated by the two polynomials f and g, because it's just a particular example of that thing.
column2: (2) 任意两个多项式 f 和 g 都有最大公因数，即生成由两个多项式 f 和 g 所生成理想的多项式 d(x)，因为这只是该结论的一个特例。

column1: And moreover, then this greatest common divisor can be written as a multiple of f(x) plus another multiple of g(x) in the polynomial ring—same proof, because these are the elements of that ideal. So this follows. Now to talk about what (3) is, we have to say what a prime is.
column2: 此外，这个最大公因数可以写为 f(x) 的倍数加上多项式环中 g(x) 的倍数——证明相同，因为它们是该理想中的元素。因此这成立。现在来谈 (3) 是什么，我们必须说明什么是素多项式。

column1: So we say p(x) is a prime polynomial—or more what's usually used in the literature, irreducible polynomial—if any factorization p(x) = p_1(x) p_2(x) has degree of p_1 equal to 0.
column2: 我们称 p(x) 为素多项式——或者文献中更常用的称呼：不可约多项式——如果任何分解 p(x) = p₁(x) p₂(x) 都有 p₁ 的次数等于 0。

column1: Namely, the only way you can factor it is to pull out a constant times the polynomial of the same degree—you can always do that, right?
column2: 也就是说，你唯一能分解它的方式就是提常数乘以同次多项式——你总能这么做，对吧？

column1: So the only factors of p(x) are either polynomials of degree 0 or polynomials of degree equal to deg(p)—no smaller factors.
column2: 所以 p(x) 的因子要么是0 次多项式，要么是与 p(x) 同次的多项式，没有更小次数的真因子。

column1: And then it implies that if you have two polynomials a and p, the gcd of a(x) and p(x)—the ideal generated by a(x) and p(x)—is either equal to the unit ideal (1) or the ideal generated by p(x),
column2: 于是这意味着如果你有两个多项式 a 和 p，a(x)与 p(x) 的最大公因数——即由 a(x) 和 p(x) 生成的理想——要么等于单位理想 (1)，

column1: because if you have a polynomial that divides p(x), it either generates the same ideal as p(x) or it generates the unit ideal.
column2: 要么等于由 p(x) 生成的理想，因为如果有整除 p(x) 的多项式，它要么生成与 p(x) 相同的理想，要么生成单位理想。

column1: So p_1 here would generate the unit ideal and p_2 would generate the same ideal as p. So the only possible divisors of p(x) are 1 and p.
column2: 因此这里的 p₁ 生成单位理想，而 p₂ 生成与 p 相同的理想。所以 p(x) 唯一可能的因子就是 1 和 p。

column1: And so if p(x) divides a(x), the gcd is this ideal (p); and if it doesn't, the gcd is the ideal (1).
